form_analysis.feedback: Excellent aftercare form for non-ablative laser resurfacing with clear guidance on the 'no downtime' paradox. Strong emphasis on the extended collagen remodeling timeline and sun protection. Realistic expectations about gradual improvement with multiple sessions.

form_data.introduction: This aftercare is for NON-ABLATIVE laser resurfacing (e.g., 1320nm, 1440nm, 1540nm lasers). The laser heats the dermis without damaging the epidermis - 'no downtime' but significant subsurface healing. Collagen stimulation occurs invisibly over months.

instructions.general_directive: Follow for 24-48 hours for surface care, with collagen support for 3-6 months. Minimal downtime but requires patience for results.

sections.title: Non-Ablative Mechanism
sections.content: Laser passes through epidermis to heat dermis to 60-70°C, stimulating fibroblasts without epidermal injury. No open wound, but significant inflammatory response beneath surface.

sections.title: Immediate Post-Treatment Response
items: Mild to moderate redness (like sunburn) for 2-48 hours.

sections.title: Subsurface Healing Timeline
items: Days 1-3: Surface redness resolves. Skin may feel dry/tight.
Months 1-3: Gradual improvement in texture, fine lines.
Months 3-6: Peak collagen remodeling, optimal results.

sections.title: Skincare for Collagen Support
items: Hydration: Hyaluronic acid serums to support healing.
Antioxidants: Vitamin C serum after 24 hours.
Growth factors/peptides to enhance fibroblast activity.
Retinoids: May continue if tolerated, or resume after 1 week.

sections.title: Sun Protection (CRITICAL)
sections.content: Even without surface damage, UV exposure degrades new collagen. Daily SPF 30+ mandatory for 3-6 months. This is the most important factor for results.

sections.title: Activity Restrictions
items: Sleep elevated first night if swollen.

sections.title: Realistic Non-Ablative Expectations
items: Best for: Fine lines, mild texture, pore refinement.
Not for: Deep wrinkles, significant laxity.
